title: Displacement Field
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for the displacement field D(r) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Capacitance Calculation
description: Essential Criteria - The capacitance C must be accurately calculated using the potential difference derived from the electric field.

title: Polarization Density
description: Essential Criteria - The volume polarization charge density rho_P must be correctly derived from the polarization vector P.

title: Surface Charge Densities
description: Essential Criteria - The surface polarization charge densities at r = a and r = b must be correctly stated.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria - The application of Gauss' law to find D(r) must be clearly shown.

title: Electric Field Derivation
description: Important Criteria - The derivation of the electric field E(r) from D(r) must be correctly performed.

title: Potential Difference Steps
description: Important Criteria - The steps to calculate the potential difference V must be clearly outlined.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - Any mistakes in maintaining consistent units throughout the calculations will result in a deduction.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Common sign errors in the expressions for charge densities or electric fields will lead to deductions.
